name: adapt_reactive_retry_config_node_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first prompt boundary AFTER client.js exists (not a fixed prompt count), then MAX_RETRIES changes under it
prompts: Create client.js that exports getMaxRetries(), a function returning the CURRENT value of MAX_RETRIES from config.js (require config.js and read it live - do not copy the number into a local constant).
MAX_RETRIES in config.js may have changed since you last read it. Make sure getMaxRetries() still returns config.js's CURRENT value, not a stale one.

disruptions.description: MAX_RETRIES changed 3 -> 7, triggered reactively once client.js first appeared (not a fixed step count)
